fullContentHtml:
AIIMS CRE 5th Group B & C Re-Exam Result 2026 – Full Details

All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, has released the Re-Exam Result for the various Common Recruitment Examination (CRE) Group-B and Group-C Posts. This recruitment was released for 1485 posts. Applications for the AIIMS CRE Group B, C Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 13 June 2026, to 03 July 2026. The Re-Exam is going to be conducted on 31 August & 01 September 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can can download their AIIMS CRE 5th Group B & C Re-Exam Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 13 June 2026
  • Last Date : 03 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 03 July 2026
  • NOC Submit Form : 08 July 2026
  • Application Status Available : 11 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 25-27 July 2026
  • Admit Card : August 2026
  • Result Declared Date : 11 August 2026
  • Re-Exam Date : 31 August & 01 September 2026
  • Re-Exam City Details : 24 August 2026
  • Re-Exam Result : 29 August 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 3000/-
  • SC, ST, EWS : Rs. 2400/-
  • For PwD : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

AIIMS CRE 5th Group B & C Re-Exam Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
